# Vendored: do not edit

A copy of [agent-skills](https://github.com/ghostaff-ai/agent-skills/tree/b1a2b7133fc4101b4ec997d265bef91d969b0e77),
commit `b1a2b7133fc4101b4ec997d265bef91d969b0e77`.

Refresh it with the workspace's `vendor-agent-skills.py`, never by hand: a local edit is
overwritten by the next refresh. A change belongs in agent-skills; a value only this repo
needs belongs in its `AGENTS.md` or `.agents/*.config.json`.
